shortDescription: Check Sync status of objects available in the VM migration task

options.name: cluster
options.description: IP or FQDN for the Cohesity Cluster

options.name: cohesity_admin
options.description: Username with which Ansible will connect to the Cohesity Cluster. Domain Specific credentails can be configured in following formats AD.domain.com/username AD.domain.com/username@tenant LOCAL/username@tenant

options.name: cohesity_password
options.description: Password belonging to the selected Username.  This parameter will not be logged.

options.name: end_time
options.description: Restore tasks will be filtered by a start time specified. If not provided the end time is the current time.

options.name: start_time
options.description: Restore tasks will be filtered by a start time specified. If not provided the start time is set to the last week. Provide value as "origin" for using cluster creation date.

options.name: state
options.description: Determines the state of the Recovery Job. (C)present a recovery job will be created and started. (C)absent is currently not implemented

options.name: task_id
options.description: Task Id of the migrate job.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Switch determines if SSL Validation should be enabled.
